comparison.objective: Verify a seat-belt retractor locks after slow payout and a jerk, then guide it home; candidate screens finishing media.
comparison.physical_skill: Velocity-profile control, force loading of an inertia lock and guided retraction versus pouring and bounded agitation of a loaded screen.
comparison.success_condition: Slow payout ≥120 mm, jerk-lock within 25 mm, ≥6 N hold, then slow return and released dwell; candidate requires ≥98% media recovery and washer retention.
comparison.reason: The seat-belt task tests dynamic lock response and controlled webbing motion, not screening.
